# Music

Create original background music and soundtracks from a description of genre, mood, instruments and tempo, generated as audio files for videos, podcasts, games and ads.

## What it does
Describe the genre, mood, instruments and tempo, and whether it has vocals. Claude picks a model (Lyria 3 by default), tells you the price, and creates the track in your account.

**How the files are made:** each track is generated by an audio model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Track length depends on the model.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install music@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Music talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/music/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each track uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The track plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the link.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_track_models` | Models for music tracks with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_track_cost` | Exact price of one music track before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_track` | Starts one music track in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_track` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Upbeat lo-fi hip hop for a study vlog, no vocals"
- "Epic orchestral trailer music with drums, 60 seconds"
- "A cheerful acoustic jingle for a bakery ad"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the track (the genre, the mood, the instruments and the tempo) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
